records.stem:
In October 2026, a pharmacy's outdated software blocks a clozapine refill solely because it cannot obtain a REMS authorization. The prescription is valid. The pharmacist has not yet completed the patient-specific safety review.

Which approach reflects the FDA's removal of the clozapine REMS? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: In October 2026, a pharmacy's outdated software blocks a clozapine refill solely because it cannot obtain a REMS authorization. The prescription is valid. The pharmacist has not yet completed the patient-specific safety review.
records.lead_in: Which approach reflects the FDA's removal of the clozapine REMS? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Remove the obsolete REMS gate; complete the remaining safety review.
Dispense immediately because removal of the program also ended ANC monitoring recommendations.
Transfer the prescription exclusively to a clozapine-REMS-certified pharmacy.
Require the patient to reenroll before considering the refill.

choice_analysis.A: 2025-06-13 REMS 제거 후 과거 authorization은 조제 조건이 아니다. ANC 등 current labeling 기반 안전 검토는 남는다.
choice_analysis.B: REMS의 행정 요건 제거가 neutropenia 위험이나 label 기반 monitoring까지 없애지는 않는다.
choice_analysis.C: 과거 certification 경로를 현재 필수 유통 제한으로 적용하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: 제거된 프로그램의 enrollment를 현재 필수 조건으로 되살리지 않는다.

records.stem:
A pharmacist calls the treating physician to resolve an interaction affecting the patient's current therapy. A coworker says the HIPAA minimum-necessary rule prohibits a treatment-related exchange unless the patient signs a new authorization.

Which explanation is most accurate? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A pharmacist calls the treating physician to resolve an interaction affecting the patient's current therapy. A coworker says the HIPAA minimum-necessary rule prohibits a treatment-related exchange unless the patient signs a new authorization.
records.lead_in: Which explanation is most accurate? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Minimum necessary requires a separate authorization for each drug discussed.
The exception applies to insurer payment reviews but not clinician treatment discussions.
Treatment disclosures between providers have a specific minimum-necessary exception.
The exception permits coworkers to browse any patient chart without a work-related purpose.

explanation.core_reasoning: TPO상 허용과 minimum necessary의 명시적 예외를 구분한다. 정당한 치료를 위한 정보 교환과 업무 목적 없는 내부 열람은 같지 않다.

choice_analysis.A: 이 예외에 각 약마다 별도 authorization이 필요하다는 제한을 붙이지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: Payment와 provider treatment의 적용 관계를 반대로 설명한 것이다.
choice_analysis.C: 치료를 위한 provider 간 공개·요청의 minimum-necessary 예외와 실제 치료 목적을 함께 확인한다.
choice_analysis.D: Treatment 예외가 내부 curiosity access를 허용하지 않는다.

records.stem:
A pharmacy posts its Notice of Privacy Practices but gives every employee the same electronic-record login. It cannot identify which employee opened a patient record.

Which change most directly addresses the described electronic safeguard weakness? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A pharmacy posts its Notice of Privacy Practices but gives every employee the same electronic-record login. It cannot identify which employee opened a patient record.
records.lead_in: Which change most directly addresses the described electronic safeguard weakness? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A common login restricted to licensed staff with no individual log.
One workstation password and a signed privacy-notice receipt.
Individual authentication, role-based permissions, and an access log.
A shared password changed weekly and a printed staff roster.

explanation.core_reasoning: Privacy notice 제공과 ePHI 보안 통제는 별도 층이다. 이 문제는 특정 소프트웨어 구매 의무가 아니라 공유 로그인으로 인한 추적성 문제를 묻는다.

choice_analysis.A: 직원 자격 제한만으로 특정 개인의 접근을 확인하는 문제를 해결하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: NPP 수령 기록은 공유 계정의 개별 접근 추적을 대체하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.C: 개인별 신원·업무 범위·실제 열람의 추적성을 함께 개선한다.
choice_analysis.D: 비밀번호 교체·근무표만으로 누가 전자 기록을 열람했는지 확인할 수 없다.

records.stem:
A covered pharmacy receives a valid patient request for access to an ordinary designated record set. No ground for denial applies. By day 25, it knows it cannot act within the initial 30-calendar-day period.

What is required to use the permitted extension? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A covered pharmacy receives a valid patient request for access to an ordinary designated record set. No ground for denial applies. By day 25, it knows it cannot act within the initial 30-calendar-day period.
records.lead_in: What is required to use the permitted extension? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Wait until day 30 has passed, then begin an automatic 30-business-day extension.
Use successive 30-day extensions if a written explanation is sent each month.
Send written reasons and a completion date before the initial 30 days end.
Ask the records vendor to restart the clock when it receives the forwarded request.

explanation.core_reasoning: 30일이라는 숫자보다 수령 시점·calendar days·서면 통지 시점·한 번의 연장이라는 조건을 함께 적용한다.

choice_analysis.A: 자동 연장도 business-day 전환도 해당 규칙이 아니다.
choice_analysis.B: 허용되는 연장은 한 번이며 반복적인 월별 연장으로 바꿀 수 없다.
choice_analysis.C: §164.524(b)(2)는 초기 기간 안의 서면 이유·완료일과 한 번의 최대 30일 연장을 요구한다.
choice_analysis.D: Business associate로 전달했다고 pharmacy가 받은 요청의 시계가 새로 시작되지 않는다.

records.stem:
An adult patient sends a neighbor to collect a prescription and permits discussion of its administration instructions. The neighbor also asks for the patient's unrelated mental-health medication history.

Which response best respects the scope of the patient's permission? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: An adult patient sends a neighbor to collect a prescription and permits discussion of its administration instructions. The neighbor also asks for the patient's unrelated mental-health medication history.
records.lead_in: Which response best respects the scope of the patient's permission? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Give the complete history because collecting the bag establishes personal-representative status.
Limit the discussion to the authorized pickup information.
Release the unrelated history if the neighbor pays the copayment.
Refuse administration instructions unless the neighbor presents a court order.

explanation.core_reasoning: 환자 대리 pickup의 허용된 관련 정보와 unrelated record disclosure를 분리한다. 무조건 전부 공개·무조건 전부 금지라는 두 극단을 피한다.

choice_analysis.A: 약을 대신 찾는 행위만으로 모든 의료기록 접근권을 갖는 personal representative가 되지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: Pickup에 관련된 범위와 환자가 허용하지 않은 전체·민감 기록은 구별한다.
choice_analysis.C: 약값 지불은 unrelated PHI 공개의 포괄적 권한이 아니다.
choice_analysis.D: 환자의 허용된 pickup 관련 설명까지 법원 명령이 있어야 하는 것은 아니다.

records.stem:
For a vaccine requiring a VIS, the pharmacy prepares to give the patient a VIS link on the receipt after the injection. The patient has not received the VIS in any other form.

Which change is needed? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: For a vaccine requiring a VIS, the pharmacy prepares to give the patient a VIS link on the receipt after the injection. The patient has not received the VIS in any other form.
records.lead_in: Which change is needed? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Replace the VIS with the pharmacy's privacy notice before the injection.
Give the link with the post-injection receipt because the lot is documented.
Make the appropriate VIS available to the patient before this injection.
Provide the VIS only if the patient later reports an adverse event.

explanation.core_reasoning: 문서가 실제로 제공됐는지와 언제 제공됐는지를 모두 확인한다. 이 문제는 적격 전자 제공을 금지하는 문제가 아니다.

choice_analysis.A: Privacy notice는 vaccine information document를 대신하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: 제품 lot 기록과 환자의 사전 정보 제공은 별개다.
choice_analysis.C: 해당 VIS는 접종 전에 환자 또는 법정대리인에게 제공해야 한다.
choice_analysis.D: VAERS 등 사후 사건 대응과 사전 VIS 의무를 혼동한 것이다.

records.stem:
A pharmacy administers influenza vaccine under a valid order and all personnel and product conditions are met. An employee interprets the policy's influenza exception to mandatory pre-administration MIIS review as permission not to report the dose.

How should this interpretation be corrected? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A pharmacy administers influenza vaccine under a valid order and all personnel and product conditions are met. An employee interprets the policy's influenza exception to mandatory pre-administration MIIS review as permission not to report the dose.
records.lead_in: How should this interpretation be corrected? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Require a new patient prescription solely to restore the reporting obligation.
Apply the exception only when the vaccine was paid for in cash.
Use a VAERS entry in place of the missing routine immunization report.
Report this dose even though the specified pre-administration query is excepted.

explanation.core_reasoning: 조회와 데이터 전송은 별도 행위다. 같은 시스템 이름 아래 있다는 이유로 한 예외를 다른 의무에 확대하지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: 보고 의무가 새 처방을 받아야만 다시 생기는 구조가 아니다.
choice_analysis.B: 지급 방식으로 해당 MIIS 예외를 정한 규칙이 아니다.
choice_analysis.C: VAERS와 MIIS는 다른 목적·trigger의 시스템이다.
choice_analysis.D: Influenza/COVID의 지정 조회 예외가 MIIS 투약 기록 보고까지 면제하지 않는다.

records.stem:
A fully qualified Massachusetts technician immunizer is working under the required pharmacist supervision. A patient asks which of two products is appropriate for a previously undocumented reaction. The pharmacist has not selected the vaccine or counseled the patient.

What should occur before the technician proceeds? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A fully qualified Massachusetts technician immunizer is working under the required pharmacist supervision. A patient asks which of two products is appropriate for a previously undocumented reaction. The pharmacist has not selected the vaccine or counseled the patient.
records.lead_in: What should occur before the technician proceeds? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The technician should use national certification as authority to decide independently.
The technician should choose whichever product is already prepared.
The cashier should obtain a refusal of counseling so the technician can choose.
Have the pharmacist assess the reaction, select the vaccine, and counsel.

explanation.core_reasoning: 투여 기술의 자격은 제품 선택·임상 상담의 권한과 다르다. 적격한 기술자가 있어도 약사에게 남는 판단은 수행해야 한다.

choice_analysis.A: National certification만으로 독립 임상 판단 권한이 생기지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: 준비된 제품의 존재가 clinical selection 권한을 주지 않는다.
choice_analysis.C: 상담 거절을 받는 것으로 비약사의 제품 선택 권한을 만들 수 없다.
choice_analysis.D: Technician의 preparation·administration 권한과 pharmacist의 vaccine selection·counseling을 분리한다.

records.stem:
A vaccine is administered and an event meeting an applicable VAERS reporting requirement occurs. The pharmacy has entered the administration into MIIS.

Which statement best describes the reporting relationship? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A vaccine is administered and an event meeting an applicable VAERS reporting requirement occurs. The pharmacy has entered the administration into MIIS.
records.lead_in: Which statement best describes the reporting relationship? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The pharmacy should delete the MIIS entry before submitting VAERS.
Report the adverse event through VAERS as well as recording the MIIS dose.
The MIIS entry serves as the required VAERS submission if the lot number matches.
VAERS submission must wait for proof that the vaccine caused the event.

explanation.core_reasoning: Reportable event의 요건과 causation 확정을 구별한다. 보고 하나를 했다는 사실이 다른 reporting pathway의 의무를 없애지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: 정상 투약 기록을 지워야 이상사건 보고가 가능하다는 조건은 없다.
choice_analysis.B: 투약 기록과 이상사건 보고는 별도 system·trigger이다.
choice_analysis.C: Lot가 같아도 다른 기관·목적의 보고가 자동 대체되지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: 적용되는 reportable-event 조건을 충족하면 완전한 인과관계 확정까지 미루는 구조가 아니다.

records.stem:
A supervising physician refers an adult patient for retail CDTM. The pharmacist has the referral and the original consent remains in the physician's record. The physician asks when the consent copy must be sent to the pharmacist.

Which deadline applies to this communication? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A supervising physician refers an adult patient for retail CDTM. The pharmacist has the referral and the original consent remains in the physician's record. The physician asks when the consent copy must be sent to the pharmacist.
records.lead_in: Which deadline applies to this communication? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Within 48 hours.
Within 7 calendar days.
Within 72 hours.
Within 24 hours.

explanation.core_reasoning: 같은 24시간이라도 새 prescription/change 사본 전달과 consent copy 전달은 의무자·시작 사건이 다르다.

choice_analysis.A: 노트의 해당 전달 기한은 48시간이 아니다.
choice_analysis.B: 다른 기관 보고의 일반 기한과 이번 환자별 copy 전달은 별개다.
choice_analysis.C: 다른 보고 의무의 시계를 consent 전달에 적용하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: Retail consent copy를 physician에서 pharmacist로 전달하는 기한이다.

records.stem:
A physician wants a Massachusetts community pharmacist to issue testosterone prescriptions under a retail CDTM agreement. The patient is an adult and both clinicians meet their qualifications. The proposed agreement explicitly names testosterone.

What is the relevant limitation? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A physician wants a Massachusetts community pharmacist to issue testosterone prescriptions under a retail CDTM agreement. The patient is an adult and both clinicians meet their qualifications. The proposed agreement explicitly names testosterone.
records.lead_in: What is the relevant limitation? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The pharmacist may prescribe it because testosterone is not an opioid.
The pharmacist may prescribe it after adding one extra CE hour.
The community CDTM pathway excludes prescribing of Schedule II–V drugs.
The agreement becomes sufficient if the prescription is limited to 30 days.

choice_analysis.A: Non-opioid라는 분류는 retail CDTM schedule 제한을 면제하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: 추가 교육시간을 임의로 붙여 statutory scope를 확장할 수 없다.
choice_analysis.C: Retail/community CPA의 II–V prescribing 금지는 계약서에 약 이름을 적어도 없앨 수 없다.
choice_analysis.D: Supply 제한을 낮춰도 해당 prescribing 권한 자체의 결함은 해결되지 않는다.

records.stem:
A pharmacy and physician are updating a CDTM agreement. They also need a process for patients if the agreement is not renewed.

Which provisions are consistent with the described CDTM requirements? Select ALL that apply.

records.lead_in: Which provisions are consistent with the described CDTM requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Arrange uninterrupted drug-therapy continuation before termination or nonrenewal.
Review and renew the agreement at least every two years.
Delegate pharmacist prescribing decisions to a technician through an agreement clause.
Keep the old agreement active indefinitely after the supervising physician leaves practice.
Provide patients written notice and instructions for continuing care when the agreement ends.

choice_analysis.B: CPA의 적어도 2년마다 review·renew 요건이다.
choice_analysis.C: CPA 문구는 technician의 법정 scope를 확대하지 않는다.

choice_analysis.E: 환자 통지·치료 지속 안내를 직원 간 문서로만 대신하지 않는다.

records.stem:
A customer selects an FDA-approved OTC naloxone product and pays without requesting prescription insurance billing. The cashier says a patient-specific prescription is required because the pharmacy also uses a statewide standing order.

Which distinction should the pharmacist explain? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A customer selects an FDA-approved OTC naloxone product and pays without requesting prescription insurance billing. The cashier says a patient-specific prescription is required because the pharmacy also uses a statewide standing order.
records.lead_in: Which distinction should the pharmacist explain? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: OTC purchase and prescription billing are separate pathways.
The statewide order converts the OTC product into a prescription-only product.
Any OTC naloxone purchaser must enroll in an opioid-treatment program.

A pharmacy keeps expired controlled-substance stock in a secured quarantine area while arranging lawful disposition. Staff propose excluding it from the on-hand inventory because it is no longer available for dispensing.

What is the appropriate inventory treatment? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A pharmacy keeps expired controlled-substance stock in a secured quarantine area while arranging lawful disposition. Staff propose excluding it from the on-hand inventory because it is no longer available for dispensing.
records.lead_in: What is the appropriate inventory treatment? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Exclude it when the product expiration date passes.
Include the secured stock in the applicable on-hand accounting.
Count only the portion expected to generate a financial credit.
Exclude it as soon as a reverse-distribution pickup is requested.

explanation.core_reasoning: Dispensable quantity와 legally accountable on-hand quantity는 다를 수 있다. 격리·반품대기 상태도 기록해야 한다.

choice_analysis.A: Expiry만으로 controlled status나 on-hand 책임이 종료되지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: 사용 가능 재고가 아니라도 소지·통제하는 expired/damaged stock의 accountability는 남는다.
choice_analysis.C: 회계상 credit 가능성이 재고법의 대상 수량을 결정하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: Pickup 예약과 실제 적법한 인계는 같은 사건이 아니다.

A pharmacy discovers a confirmed controlled-substance theft. Its investigation will take several weeks. The manager proposes making no written contact with DEA until the completed electronic Form 106 is ready.

Which timeline correctly separates the two federal duties? Select ONE answer.
records.scenario: A pharmacy discovers a confirmed controlled-substance theft. Its investigation will take several weeks. The manager proposes making no written contact with DEA until the completed electronic Form 106 is ready.
records.lead_in: Which timeline correctly separates the two federal duties? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Notice: 45 days after discovery; Form 106: 1 business day after notice.
Notice: 1 business day; completed Form 106: 45 days after discovery.
Notice: 1 business day; completed Form 106: 45 days after investigation ends.
Notice and completed Form 106: both 45 days after discovery.

explanation.core_reasoning: 2026-10-27 열람한 현행 eCFR의 45일과 1-business-day를 적용한다. Massachusetts의 별도 보고 의무는 이 연방 문항과 구별해 남는다.

choice_analysis.A: 초기 통지와 후속 양식의 기간·순서를 뒤집었다.
choice_analysis.B: 현행 열람 §1301.76(b)의 각 기한이다. 두 시계 모두 discovery에 연결된다.
choice_analysis.C: 후속 양식의 시작점도 discovery이며 조사 종료로 미루지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: 후속 보고기간을 이용해 1-business-day 초기 서면 통지를 없앴다.
